description: Foundation: db row types, schema (bookmarks + activities tables, indexes, RLS, policies + incremental migration block), and feed/sample-type wiring for viewer bookmarked state. Everything else depends on this. Must not break the Trending/Latest split or rankByEngagement. (design.md §1, §4; types from §3.7/§6.)
steps: In src/types/db.ts add: `ActivityVerb` = string-union of the six verbs ('created_post','commented','reacted','joined_group','created_group','bookmarked'); `interface Bookmark { post_id: string; user_id: string; created_at: string }`; `interface Activity { id: string; user_id: string; verb: ActivityVerb; target_type: string | null; target_id: string | null; group_id: string | null; created_at: string }`. Single canonical name Activity (no ActivityRow alias).

In supabase/schema.sql canonical sections (design §1.1-§1.6): add `create table if not exists public.bookmarks` (post_id uuid FK->posts(id) on delete cascade, user_id uuid FK->profiles(id) on delete cascade, created_at timestamptz not null default now(), primary key (post_id,user_id)) and `create table if not exists public.activities` (id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid not null FK->profiles(id) on delete cascade, verb text not null CHECK verb in the six verbs, target_type text, target_id uuid, group_id uuid references public.groups(id) on delete set null, created_at timestamptz not null default now()). Add `create index if not exists bookmarks_user_created_idx on public.bookmarks (user_id, created_at desc)` and `activities_user_created_idx on public.activities (user_id, created_at desc)`. In the RLS-enable section add `alter table public.bookmarks enable row level security` and the same for activities.

In supabase/schema.sql RLS Policies section add drop-then-create policies: bookmarks_select FOR select TO authenticated USING (user_id = auth.uid()); bookmarks_insert FOR insert TO authenticated WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid() and public.can_read_post(post_id)); bookmarks_delete FOR delete TO authenticated USING (user_id = auth.uid()); activities_select FOR select TO authenticated USING (user_id = auth.uid()); activities_insert FOR insert TO authenticated WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid()). No anon grants. No UPDATE/DELETE on activities. NEVER a direct posts/groups subselect.

Append the clearly-marked incremental migration block to the BOTTOM of supabase/schema.sql, after the existing likes->reactions migration (design §1.7): a banner comment ('INCREMENTAL MIGRATION: add bookmarks + activities — run ONCE in the Supabase SQL editor; touches no existing data; safe to re-run'), then in order the two create-table-if-not-exists, the two create-index-if-not-exists, the two alter-table enable RLS, and the five drop-policy/create-policy pairs — byte-identical in effect to the canonical statements. References only pre-existing objects (posts, profiles, groups, can_read_post).
In src/lib/sampleFeed.ts add `bookmarked: boolean;` to the SamplePost interface and `bookmarked: false` to each of the three samplePosts objects. Leave reposts and all other fields untouched.

In src/lib/feed.ts fetchFeedPosts (design §4.2): change the Promise.all from a 3-tuple to a fixed 4-tuple destructured [reactionsRes, commentsRes, authorsRes, bmRes]; add as the 4th entry the typed ternary `user ? supabase.from('bookmarks').select('post_id').eq('user_id', user.id).in('post_id', postIds).returns<{ post_id: string }[]>() : Promise.resolve({ data: [] as { post_id: string }[] })`. Build `const bookmarkedSet = new Set((bmRes.data ?? []).map((b) => b.post_id));`. In the final .map add `bookmarked: user ? bookmarkedSet.has(p.id) : false,` to the returned object. Do NOT touch rankByEngagement, ordering, or slicing.
In src/lib/feed.ts add the `export` keyword to the existing `function timeAgo(...)` (needed by /activity in FEAT-003). Do not change its behavior.
In tests/feed.test.ts add `bookmarked: false` to the object returned by the makePost helper so it satisfies the extended SamplePost.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` passes with no type or lint errors.
`npm run test` passes (rankByEngagement ordering tests unchanged).
SamplePost has a `bookmarked: boolean` field; all sample posts set it false and remain isReal:false.
fetchFeedPosts sets bookmarked:true for a viewer's bookmarked post ids and false otherwise, with a fixed-arity Promise.all (no never[] fallback).

schema.sql defines bookmarks (PK (post_id,user_id), both FKs on delete cascade) and activities (verb CHECK over exactly six verbs, group_id FK on delete set null, id default gen_random_uuid()) idempotently, with self-scoped RLS and the bookmarks INSERT gated by can_read_post; a separate incremental migration block exists at the file bottom.
verification: Run `npm run build` in c:\Projects\AidPal and confirm no type/lint errors.
Run `npm run test` and confirm all tests pass.

Review supabase/schema.sql: confirm idempotent create-if-not-exists tables/indexes, drop-then-create policies, visibility only via can_read_post, and the self-contained incremental migration block at the bottom.
findings: Exported symbols now available to later features: `timeAgo(iso: string): string` is exported from src/lib/feed.ts (compact durations: 'just now'/'5m'/'3h'/'2d'/'1w'; returns '' for NaN). New row types in src/types/db.ts: `ActivityVerb` (union of 'created_post'|'commented'|'reacted'|'joined_group'|'created_group'|'bookmarked'), `interface Bookmark { post_id; user_id; created_at }`, `interface Activity { id; user_id; verb: ActivityVerb; target_type: string|null; target_id: string|null; group_id: string|null; created_at }` (canonical name Activity, no ActivityRow alias). SamplePost gained `bookmarked: boolean`. fetchFeedPosts Promise.all is now a fixed 4-tuple destructured `[reactionsRes, commentsRes, authorsRes, bmRes]`; bmRes is `{ data: { post_id: string }[] }` (bookmarks select gated by user, else Promise.resolve). Each returned post sets `bookmarked: user ? bookmarkedSet.has(p.id) : false`. Schema: new tables public.bookmarks (PK (post_id,user_id)) and public.activities (verb CHECK over the six verbs, group_id FK on delete set null); indexes bookmarks_user_created_idx and activities_user_created_idx; RLS self-scoped with policies bookmarks_select/insert/delete (insert gated by can_read_post) and activities_select/insert (no UPDATE/DELETE). A self-contained incremental migration block is appended at the file bottom after the likes->reactions block. build + test both clean (54 tests pass).
